-- Schema
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name TEXT DEFAULT 'anonymous',
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now()
);

/* An index
   over two lines */
CREATE INDEX idx_users_email ON users (lower(email));

INSERT INTO users (email, name) VALUES
    ('a@example.com', 'Alice'),
    ('b@example.com', 'Bob''s');

SELECT u.id,
       u.name,
       COUNT(o.id) AS orders,
       SUM(o.total) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'paid') AS paid
FROM users AS u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND u.email LIKE '%@example.com'
GROUP BY u.id, u.name
HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 2
ORDER BY paid DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10 OFFSET 0;

UPDATE users SET name = "quoted name" WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM bans);
DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expires < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
WITH recursive t(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM t WHERE n < 5)
SELECT n, CASE WHEN n % 2 = 0 THEN 'even' ELSE 'odd' END FROM t;
